digest.component_or_area: code-review project criterion dogfood and deployment validation
propositions: A live Gerrit review bot must load and execute the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion from the deployed rebar repository through the four-pass pipeline to prove end-to-end project-criterion execution without blocking contributors.

Four sequential patchsets against a single Gerrit change must demonstrate: positive control (valid discovery refinement, no project finding), historical severity-only stimulus (abstention due to phase-naming omission), predeclared FIRE control RP-F2 (project advisory with reviewer_id and criteria present), and final cleaned revision (phase-compliant, submitted to main).

The project-attributed advisory finding from patchset 3 must carry reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], Pass-2 validity/impact/verification data, and Pass-3 decision=advisory with block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.
Blocking must remain disabled throughout the entire probe; blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 are inert configuration constants, not subject to change by this story.

All four patchsets must be observed via acceptable code_review_result_v2 artifacts with coverage.llm_ran=true; their blocking, advisory, dropped, and indeterminate verdict buckets must be compared without claiming unavailable per-criterion execution counters.
The dogfood story is observational only; blocking promotion is deferred to a separate future ticket backed by production review data, and no rubric or threshold tuning occurs based on probe results.
